triage.desk_query: Term sheet G02 states: "Autocall Observation Dates 2027-05-12, 2027-11-12, 2028-05-12", but the booking record field autocall_observation_dates holds ['2027-05-12', '2027-11-15', '2028-05-12'] — the second observation is booked as 15 Nov 2027 against a documented 12 Nov 2027. The first and third dates tie out exactly, so this looks like a single-date entry or adjustment applied to observation 2 only; note 12 Nov 2027 is a Friday, so a weekend roll does not explain it. Please confirm whether the booked 2027-11-15 reflects an intended business-day or holiday adjustment under the note's terms, or whether the booking should be corrected to 2027-11-12 per the term sheet.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous, explicitly labelled schedule in the term sheet and two of the three dates match the booking, so the isolated three-day shift in the second date points to a booking entry error rather than a document defect.
